authorized_tariff: Owner selected Upstox Basic - published standard tariff
broker_effective_from_note: Observation date is not an invented effective date; historical use is a counterfactual selected-tariff assumption.
scope: Ordinary NSE cash equity shares; not derivatives, funds, REIT/InvIT, BSE scrip groups or negotiated tariffs.

sources.fact: Basic per executed order: delivery min(INR20,2.5%); intraday min(INR20,0.1%).

Cash-share STT delivery 0.1% buy and sell; intraday 0.025% sell. Stamp delivery 0.015% buy, intraday 0.003% buy. Standard DP INR20 plus GST per scrip/sell day; intraday none. SEBI INR10/crore. No expired 2025 API discount applied.
Cash exchange fee INR297/crore/side; pre-March-2026 IPFT INR10/crore/side shown in FA73061.
Cash exchange INR306.99/crore and IPFT INR0.01/crore per side. Combined INR307/crore unchanged; do not add old IPFT on top of new combined charge.
Confirms equity-share STT, stamp and SEBI rates, and distinct delivery/non-delivery tax treatment.
Centralized stamp rates: delivery 0.015%, non-delivery 0.003%, buyer side.
GST 18% includes brokerage, transaction and SEBI fees; main tariff additionally specifies IPFT/DP. Model uses all five service components.
Basic brokerage and standard DP corroboration; personal/negotiated concessions are not inferred.

assumptions: One paper open or pyramid is one buy order; one partial/final close is one sell order. Partial broker fills of a single order are not separate orders in this model.
Rounding: INR0.01 half-up per component, GST on rounded service components. Contract-note/day statutory rounding can differ.
Same IST day delivery sales allocate the intraday buy fee and rebate paid excess; remaining delivery quantities retain their buy allocations.
DP once per exact ticker/IST sell day, durable through JSON/Mongo; canonical ticker identity required. Depository/ISIN transfers and broker-specific exemptions are not reconstructed.

Intraday held overnight is explicitly an unverified product estimate: conversion, forced broker square-off, auction, interest and penalties are unknown. Paper scheduled exits are app orders, not proof of a broker auto-square-off fee.
New unsupported exchange/known fund entries are refused with reason. Existing unsupported holdings keep protective exits with explicitly unavailable legacy estimates.
Known ETF/fund identifiers and configured sectors are refused; other NSE cash names carry an explicit ordinary_equity_share assumption, not a verified security master.
Historical costs and P&L remain original. Read-only comparisons show current selected broker tariff with dated statutory schedules; missing order history/coverage is labelled.
